# NoteSpaceLLM

## Last-checked: 2026-09-22

> Local-first document notebook for document research and report generation with configurable local or remote language models. Latest full Windows run (2026-10-12): 200 Python tests passed and 0 were skipped. Separately on 2026-10-12, all 62 Web Companion tests passed.

## Description

NoteSpaceLLM is a local-first PySide6 desktop application for document analysis. Project files and the ChromaDB index are stored locally by default. When a remote model or embedding endpoint is configured, the text and prompts used for that operation are sent to the selected endpoint. The app supports Ollama (local and remote), OpenAI, Anthropic, and Claude Code workflows, and exports results to Markdown, PDF, DOCX, HTML, and TXT. A Web/PWA Companion reviews user-created workspace exports on Android, iOS, and browser devices without a document-upload service.

## Type

- Desktop application (PySide6, Python)
- Web/PWA Companion (static, JavaScript)
- Open source (AGPL-3.0-only)

## Language / Platform

- Python 3.10+
- PySide6 (multiple upstream licensing options; see resolved distribution license files)
- Windows, macOS, Linux

## Key Features

- Local document management: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, XLSX, EML, MSG
- ChromaDB stores the vector index locally; the configured embedding endpoint may be remote
- Multi-provider LLM support: Ollama (local + remote), OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude Code
- Auto-indexing: new documents are processed and indexed immediately on add
- Sub-queries: right-click a document for document-specific research
- Workflow visualization with report builder
- Chat interface over loaded documents
- Multi-format export: MD, PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT
- Prompt export for external LLM workflows (Claude Code integration)
- Web/PWA Companion for mobile review of exported workspaces
- The Web/PWA Companion has a six-language UI (de, en, es, zh, ja, ru); the desktop UI is currently primarily German, and report language does not select a desktop UI language
- PEP 621 pyproject.toml configuration with pytest pythonpath integration
- macOS and Linux source smoke tests in GitHub Actions
- Community workflows use `actions/stale@v10` and `actions/first-interaction@v3`

## Audience

- Privacy-conscious researchers and knowledge workers who need a local NotebookLM alternative
- Developers evaluating local-first PySide6 desktop apps with ChromaDB and configurable LLM providers
- Teams using local Ollama endpoints for document analysis without cloud-provider transfer
- Anyone who wants local-model document analysis, report generation, and mobile review via PWA Companion
